impact: A clean beat and raise from the biggest neocloud eases AI-bubble fears around NBIS ahead of its Nov 12 report (options price about +/-17%). The $132.5B backlog also supports GPU and memory demand for MU and DRAM, though heavy capex and debt stay the bear case.
summary: CoreWeave Q3 revenue rose 168% to $3.66B vs about $3.55B expected, and the loss per share of $1.27 was narrower than forecast. It raised 2026 revenue guidance to $13B-$13.3B vs $12.86B consensus, expects to exit the year at a $20B-$21B run-rate, and ended the quarter with a $132.5B backlog. Full-year capex is guided at $37B-$39B. Shares closed at $48.73 and rose roughly 2% to 7% after hours, after falling more than 40% in a month.
title: CoreWeave beats Q3 at $3.66B, lifts 2026 revenue guide to $13-13.3B
